name: Tag

examples.title: Light Tag
examples.code:
<Tags>
  <Tag color="primary" isLight>
    Light Primary
  </Tag>
  <Tag color="danger" isLight>
    Light Danger
  </Tag>
</Tags>

examples.title: Delete Tag (Button)
examples.code:
<Tags hasAddons>
  <Tag color="primary">React</Tag>
  <Tag
    isDelete
    aria-label="Remove React"
    onDelete={() => alert('Removed React')}
  />
</Tags>

examples.title: Combined Styles
examples.code:
<Tag color="success" size="medium" isRounded m="2">
  Combined Tag
</Tag>

examples.title: All Colors
examples.code:
<Tags>
  {(
    [
      'primary',
      'link',
      'info',
      'success',
      'warning',
      'danger',
      'black',
      'dark',
      'light',
      'white',
    ] as const
  ).map(color => (
    <Tag key={color} color={color} isHoverable>
      {color.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + color.slice(1)}
    </Tag>
  ))}
</Tags>

examples.title: Sizes Together
examples.code:
<Block>
  {(['primary', 'success', 'danger'] as const).map(color => (
    <Tags key={color}>
      <Tag color={color} size="normal" isHoverable>
        {color.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + color.slice(1)} Normal
      </Tag>
      <Tag color={color} size="medium" isHoverable>
        {color.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + color.slice(1)} Medium
      </Tag>
      <Tag color={color} size="large" isHoverable>
        {color.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + color.slice(1)} Large
      </Tag>
    </Tags>
  ))}
</Block>

examples.title: Link or Button Tag
Tag with Delete Component
examples.code:
import { Tag, Tags, Delete } from '@allxsmith/bestax-bulma';

<Tags hasAddons>
  <Tag color="primary" size="medium">
    React
    <Delete ariaLabel="Remove React" onClick={() => alert('Removed React')} />
  </Tag>
</Tags>;

accessibility:
- **Delete buttons:** A delete tag is named "Delete tag", and a `Delete` inside a tag "Close", unless you name them. Neither says which tag it removes, so a screen reader user moving between several hears the same name each time. Name each one after its tag: `aria-label="Remove React"` on a delete tag, `ariaLabel="Remove React"` on a `Delete`.
- **Keyboard:** Delete tags are rendered as `<button>`, supporting keyboard activation. A tag that does something takes `as="button"` or `as="a"`, so a keyboard reaches it and a screen reader announces it as a button or a link. `isHoverable` only changes the look, and leaves a span out of the keyboard's reach.
- **Focus:** A link or button tag shows Bulma's focus ring on keyboard focus, as Bulma's links and buttons do.
- **Semantics:** Use tags for supplemental information, not as primary headings.
- **Contrast:** A light tag's text, and a white, black or dark tag's with `isLight`, reads against its background the way a light `Button`'s does, in both color schemes. That comes from bestax's stylesheets, as the `color` and `isLight` props' descriptions say.

:::tip
Combine `Tag` with `Tags` for grouped, multi-tag UIs.
:::
summary: The `Tag` component renders a Bulma-styled label or badge.

parts.summary: The `Tag` component renders a Bulma-styled label or badge.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render (default `span`). A tag that does something, a filter someone clicks or a topic it links to, takes `button` or `a`, so a keyboard reaches it and a screen reader announces it as a button or a link. Bulma styles both, and bestax's stylesheets give a button tag the font and text a span takes from the text around it. A button renders `type="button"` unless you pass `submit` or `reset`. A link's attributes, such as `href`, need `as="a"`, and a button's, such as `disabled`, `as="button"`. With `isDelete`, the tag renders its delete button whatever this says.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier for the tag. `light` takes the light color's own text from bestax's stylesheets. With Bulma's CSS alone, a light tag's text inherits the color around it, which on a dark page is hard to read.

props.name: isLight
props.description: Use the light color variant. The light color has none, so `color="light"` with `isLight` looks the same as without it. `white`, `black` and `dark` with `isLight` keep Bulma's light background, and bestax's stylesheets give their text the lightness a light tag's text has. With Bulma's CSS alone, their text inherits the color around it, which on a dark page is hard to read.

props.name: isDelete
props.description: Renders a delete-style tag (delete button). The button renders `type="button"`, so it does not submit a form around it, and is named "Delete tag" unless you pass an `aria-label`. An empty one, or a spread carrying `'aria-label': undefined`, keeps that name rather than leaving the button unnamed. "Delete tag" doesn't say which tag the button removes, so pass a name that does, such as `aria-label="Remove React"`.

props.name: isHoverable
props.description: Adds Bulma's hover shade and pointer cursor. It's only a look: a span tag stays out of the keyboard's reach, so a tag that does something takes `as="button"` or `as="a"` instead.
